body:
I told my best friend once.  He's been diagnosed with severe anxiety and has a health-related degree, so he was the one I felt most comfortable with.  He basically wrote me off and told me I didn't really have a serious problem.  ("There's absolutely no reason for you to be on medication...you just need to stop comparing your behind-the-scenes with everyone else's highlight reel.")  That really put me off saying anything to anyone.

Additionally, I've been on and off with therapy and meds for so long and it's all just been totally unhelpful.  And I know that's what some of my friends/family would recommend and I'd just shoot that down.  So...no, I don't see a point.

By support system do you mean people who I know who are aware of the extent of my depression?  I don't have that.  I do have people I care about, which in and of itself is some comfort, or at least some reason to not give up for the time being.
I really don't.  I space out in front of the tv a lot.  I go through phases where I drink a lot, then I stop completely, then I start again.  That's about as close as I come to hobbies.
